_provenance: Final configuration (2026-11-07), under the organisers' rules clarification of 2026-11-03: every setting is chosen on external data only (open-data cross-validation and open-data adaptation studies), never on the provided match's ground truth or video. Members: tempolens_rnd4_m0..4.pt, trained on the 10 open matches with domain randomisation (python -m tempolens.train --member k --draws 4). CV ensemble: 5 members 0.7760 (ENS5, adopted by a rule fixed before the run: >= +0.004 over 3 members' 0.7716). Test-time adaptation tta_alpha 0.5 and EATA 10 steps, decoder costs (switch 4, alive>dead 8, dead>alive 8, change bonus 1.0), team-evidence gate off, from the ADseeds study (python -m tempolens.adaptseeds --members 5; simulated, shifted and 20 real SkillCorner matches; open data only). Its rule, fixed before the run: a setting must beat no adaptation at the same costs for the 5-member ensemble and for each of the 5 members alone; the highest ensemble mean among those wins. Two settings passed and tied within 0.0001 on the ensemble (tta_alpha 0.5: 0.6476; tta_alpha 0.5 + EATA 10: 0.6475; none 0.6448). The rule's tie-break picks tta_alpha alone; the team chose tta_alpha 0.5 + EATA 10 after seeing the results, because its smallest per-member gain is larger (+0.0022 vs +0.0001) and its gain on real tracking (SkillCorner) is larger (+0.0122 vs +0.0108). The public window was not used for this choice. The team dropped the earlier +0.005 bar on 2026-11-07, after a one-off public-window sanity check that decided nothing. Without adaptation the CV argmax costs are (2, 8, 8, 0.5).
_tag_prior: 'auto' adds the self-calibrated Smart Tagging prior (tagprior.py), on open-data evidence: with synthetic tags on the cross-validated 5-member ensemble and these costs (python -m tempolens.tagstudy --draws 4 --seeds 3 --members 5) spellF1 0.7760 without the prior, 0.7841 / 0.7790 / 0.7781 / 0.7770 / 0.7754 at 0 / 10 / 20 / 35 / 50% tag team error: it helps with good tags and costs 0.0006 with random ones.
